DKU Library — August 2021 student handbook (superseded)

This extract is from an August 2021 DKU Student Handbook. It is kept as historical text. It does not describe the current dedicated library building.

In this 2021 handbook, the DKU Library is described as occupying two rooms on the first and second floor of the Academic Building. The listed phone number is (0512) 3665-7027. The listed email is dkulibrary@dukekunshan.edu.cn. The handbook also mentions a joint service relationship with Duke University Libraries (DUL).

Do not use these 2021 room locations or this 2021 phone number as the current library location or current service desk number.

Source: DKU Student Handbook dated 21.08.19, archived copy at https://sites.nicholas.duke.edu/imep-dku/files/2023/04/21.08.19DKU-Student-Handbook.pdf (retrieved 2026-09-10)
